title: heterotheca foliosa
intro: Heterotheca foliosa, commonly known as Mexican hat, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family, native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and fever, as well as acting as an expectorant to relieve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Heterotheca foliosa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating a variety of conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
